{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Only completed orders
completed_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'completed'
df_completed = df_clean[completed_mask].copy()

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate within each segment
# This controls for the confounding by segment
conv_by_channel_segment = df_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("Conversion rate by channel and customer_segment:")
print(conv_by_channel_segment)

# Compute the difference in conversion rate due to channel, within each segment
# Use difference-in-differences approach: (email - paid_search) within each segment
channel_diff = conv_by_channel_segment['email'] - conv_by_channel_segment['paid_search']
print("\nDifference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(channel_diff)

# Also compute average revenue by channel within each segment
rev_by_channel_segment = df_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nAverage revenue by channel and customer_segment:")
print(rev_by_channel_segment)

# Difference in revenue
rev_diff = rev_by_channel_segment['email'] - rev_by_channel_segment['paid_search']
print("\nDifference in average revenue (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(rev_diff)"}
